integrity: The decisive check is exact division in \(\mathbb F_4[x]\) against the paper's own Theorem 2.1. A standalone verifier checks both coefficient orders and independently enumerates the natural six-shift span, including its complete weight distribution and Hermitian Gram rank.
scientific_limitations: The correction is restricted to the first Table 2 row as printed. A typographical error could mean that a different intended generator yields different parameters. No claim is made that a \([10,6,4]_4\) hull-\(2\) code or a \([[10,4,4;2]]_4\) EAQECC is impossible by another construction.
title: The first quaternary row of Table 2 is not constacyclic as printed
